name: Slingshot VS Monsters
author: Addicting Games
description: Slingshot VS Monsters is a free physics-action game. The monsters are already here and the only one who can stop them is you and your trusty slingshot. This is a game not unlike the ages-old tale of David and Goliath. As a monstrous horde of invading evil is descending upon your humble town the only weapon that can stop them is a slingshot that wields colored balls. You will have to master the science and art of physics if you want to take down these baddies. Gravity can be your friend if you have the gumption and the will it takes to carve graceful firing lines through its oppressive pull. In this game, you'll have to make sure to use a like-colored ball to take down like-colored monsters. Yellow balls for yellow monsters, red balls for red monsters, and so on. If you fire the wrong colored ball at one of the monsters then it'll simply bounce off and have no effect. There is but one exception to this sacred rule: the black ball. The black ball is wild, it is chaotic. A black ball has the ability to vanquish any monster. Use them wisely when they pop up and pay attention to when the monsters themselves change colors because when they turn metallic grey they become momentarily unstoppable.
